item.title: Drake Sets 2026 Spotify Record for Most-Streamed Artist, Album & Song in a Single Day
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome back to 'Trending on Billboard'! Today, we're talking about the one and only Drake, who's back to breaking records. On May 15th, Spotify announced that Drake has set not one, not two, but three single-day records in 2026."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Drake is now the most-streamed artist, with the most-streamed album, 'Iceman', and the most-streamed song, 'Make Them Cry', all in a single day. And what's impressive is that 'Iceman' is just one of three albums he dropped on Friday, along with 'Maid of Honour' and 'Habibti'."
[Short music transition]
Host: "This marks Drake's first solo project since 2023's 'For All the Dogs'. And interestingly, on the song 'Make Them Cry', he name-drops the popular South Korean boy band BTS. In fact, BTS' member V even posted an Instagram story of himself and J-Hope dancing to the song, looking pretty surprised when Drake mentions them in the lyrics."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's it for today's update. Drake's back and breaking records, and we can't wait to see what's next. Thanks for tuning in to 'Trending on Billboard'!" [Outro music continues to play]
